n813fa6fa3b.headline: Rate hike odds spike for 'live' March RBA meeting
n813fa6fa3b.summary: The battle to tame inflation has been thrown into more uncertainty by conflict in Iran and the Middle East. Markets have raised the odds of a rate hike at the live March RBA meeting.
n813fa6fa3b.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives Australian bond yields, the Australian dollar and mortgage costs.

n780939f427.headline: No excuse for price rises at petrol pumps, says Micheal Martin
n780939f427.summary: Irish Taoiseach Micheal Martin said there was no excuse for petrol price rises. He said he did not want to see price gouging due to the escalating Middle East conflict.
n780939f427.why: Fuel prices feed into inflation and consumer spending, and Ireland's fuel retail margins are closely watched by policymakers.

n1b9c8a14a1.headline: USDJPY approaches 158 as interest rate differentials favour the USD
n1b9c8a14a1.summary: The dollar-yen pair is approaching 158 as interest rate differentials favour the US dollar. Fluctuating monetary policy and geopolitical tensions are also weighing.
n1b9c8a14a1.why: USD/JPY reflects the relative policy rates of the US and Japan and is a key carry-trade and currency-hedging benchmark.
n1b9c8a14a1.why_moved: Wider interest rate differentials between the US and Japan favour the dollar, pushing the pair toward 158.

ned30b4b5ea.headline: UK Gas Prices Have Nearly Doubled This Week
ned30b4b5ea.summary: UK wholesale gas prices have nearly doubled this week and oil has risen to $80 a barrel after escalating US-Iran conflict halted a critical Qatari LNG export plant.
ned30b4b5ea.why: The UK is a major gas importer and wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills, power costs and inflation. Qatar is one of the world's largest LNG exporters.
ned30b4b5ea.why_moved: A critical Qatari LNG export plant ceased production amid escalating US-Iran conflict, sharply reducing available gas supply and pushing UK wholesale prices up.

nc1911f9449.headline: Minister requests review of retail energy market
nc1911f9449.summary: Enterprise Minister Peter Burke has asked the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission to review Ireland's retail energy market.
nc1911f9449.why: Regulatory reviews of retail energy markets can affect supplier pricing, competition and consumer costs.

n62f62344ec.headline: Cricut, Inc. Reveals Decline In Q4 Bottom Line
n62f62344ec.summary: Cricut reported fourth-quarter profit of $7.79 million, or $0.04 per share, down from the prior year.
n62f62344ec.why: Cricut is a US maker of consumer crafting machines, so its quarterly results indicate demand for its products.

nd4c5e7a23d.headline: KARUMA CASH CRISIS! UEGCL Profits Drop, Debt Soars to 81.6% as Power Plants Rot —Who is Sleeping on the Job?
nd4c5e7a23d.summary: Uganda Electricity Generation Company's profits dropped while its debt rose to 81.6%, according to the report, which also questions the condition of its power plants.
nd4c5e7a23d.why: Uganda Electricity Generation Company operates state-owned hydropower plants, and its finances affect the country's power supply and public debt.

n8087c5175a.headline: Oil surges and stock futures sink as war in Iran threatens crude supply
n8087c5175a.summary: Oil futures surged Monday after US and Israeli strikes on Iran over the weekend, with the conflict spilling over into the broader region, while stock futures sank.
n8087c5175a.why: Oil price spikes raise input and fuel costs across the economy, and sharp swings often weigh on equity futures and risk appetite.

sources.name: WSVN 7News | Miami News, Weather, Sports | Fort Lauderdale

n8087c5175a.why_moved: US and Israeli strikes on Iran threatened crude supply, pushing oil higher while stock futures fell.

nbe76d429db.headline: President Trump offers new rationale for U.S. attack on Iran
nbe76d429db.summary: Israel's military said it had begun a broad wave of strikes in Tehran on Wednesday, while U.S. officials touted early gains. Democrats warned the war could widen.
nbe76d429db.why: Military escalation in the Middle East affects oil supply expectations, shipping routes and global risk sentiment.

n637b619af5.headline: Israel steps up airstrikes in Tehran, as Iran widens its response across the region
n637b619af5.summary: Israel said it launched airstrikes on Iranian missile launchers and a nuclear research site, and Iran struck back against Israel. Iran has widened its response across the region.
n637b619af5.why: Strikes on Iranian nuclear and military sites and regional retaliation raise risks to oil supply, shipping and regional stability that markets price quickly.

source.name: WSVN 7News | Miami News, Weather, Sports | Fort Lauderdale

nb0a9bc6711.headline: Russian Crude May Have A Comeback In India’s Oil Contracts As Supplies Dry Up From West Asia
nb0a9bc6711.summary: Russian crude may return to India's oil contracts as supplies from West Asia are at risk due to the Iran war. India is negotiating with the US over buying oil from Russia.
nb0a9bc6711.why: India is one of the world's largest oil importers, so its sourcing decisions affect global crude flows and prices.

n4ecb55ae20.headline: Jio Platforms appoints Dan Bailey as president to lead international business
n4ecb55ae20.summary: Jio Platforms appointed Dan Bailey as president to lead its international business, as the company plans a major IPO and seeks global 5G expansion.
n4ecb55ae20.why: Jio Platforms is the telecom and digital arm of Reliance Industries in India, and its planned IPO is a major capital markets event.

na9c24a3957.headline: Minister won't rule out tax change as Greens up demands
na9c24a3957.summary: Falling building approvals have left the government further behind its housing supply targets. Labor is weighing up tax changes as the Greens increase their demands.
na9c24a3957.why: Building approvals are a leading indicator of housing supply and construction activity, which feed into the wider Australian economy.

n1771dedeb0.headline: CBA boss calls for spending cuts, bold reform in budget
n1771dedeb0.summary: Commonwealth Bank chief executive Matt Comyn is urging business leaders to press the treasurer for ambitious spending cuts. He is also calling for bold reform in the budget.
n1771dedeb0.why: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is the country's largest bank, and its views on fiscal policy reflect the outlook for banking and the economy.

n93319f6fff.headline: Qatar LNG Halt Forces Asia to Seek Alternative Supplies
n93319f6fff.summary: India began rationing natural gas on Tuesday while Asian countries turned to the spot market to replace supplies following a Qatar LNG halt.
n93319f6fff.why: Qatar is one of the world's largest liquefied natural gas exporters, so disruptions to its cargoes tighten supply and lift prices for importing nations in Asia and Europe.
n93319f6fff.why_moved: A halt to Qatari LNG supply forces Asian buyers to compete for spot cargoes, which tends to push up gas prices and raise supply-security concerns.

n51ee27bd5a.headline: CBA boss calls for spending cuts, bold reform in budget
n51ee27bd5a.summary: CBA chief executive Matt Comyn is urging business leaders to encourage the treasurer to take an ambitious approach to spending in the budget.
n51ee27bd5a.why: The Commonwealth Bank is Australia's largest bank, and its views on fiscal policy reflect the views of major business lenders.

na6c23b69cd.headline: Nasdaq stays under pressure amid lower growth and higher inflation fears on US-Iran war
na6c23b69cd.summary: The Nasdaq remains under pressure as the US-Iran conflict creates a negative energy supply shock. Investors fear lower growth and higher inflation.
na6c23b69cd.why: The Nasdaq Composite is a major US equity index dominated by technology and growth companies, which are sensitive to interest rates and economic growth expectations.
na6c23b69cd.why_moved: The energy supply shock from the US-Iran conflict is raising both inflation and growth-slowdown fears.

n90919e0087.headline: Chinese refiners begin run cuts as Iran war tightens oil supply
n90919e0087.summary: Zhejiang Petrochemical, a major Chinese refiner backed by Saudi Aramco, is shutting a 200,000-barrel-per-day unit. Maintenance was brought forward in response to the Middle East conflict.
n90919e0087.why: Zhejiang Petrochemical is a large Chinese refiner; refinery run cuts reduce crude demand and product output in China's fuel market.

n1ebd820176.headline: Oil prices surge as Middle East tensions threaten Hormuz supply routes
n1ebd820176.summary: Crude prices rose as tensions in the Middle East put Strait of Hormuz supply routes at risk, adding a risk premium to the oil market.
n1ebd820176.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruption there quickly feeds into global crude benchmarks and fuel costs.
n1ebd820176.why_moved: The article cites Middle East tensions threatening Hormuz supply routes, which raises the risk premium on crude.

n3b421789f9.headline: Dow drops 400 after trimming an early plunge of 1,200 as oil prices climb even higher
n3b421789f9.summary: The Dow trimmed an early plunge of 1,200 points as oil prices climbed further on worries about the widening war with Iran. Moves eased substantially as the day progressed.
n3b421789f9.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average is a price-weighted index of 30 large US blue-chip companies. Oil price swings feed into inflation expectations, corporate costs and energy-sector earnings.
n3b421789f9.why_moved: Oil prices rose further on concerns about the widening war with Iran, which drove the early sell-off. The decline was partly reversed later in the session.

n499bcbdeb1.headline: AM Best sees war impacting range of insurance lines
n499bcbdeb1.summary: AM Best says accelerated Middle East conflict could affect a range of insurance lines. Insureds are advised to review business interruption terms and conditions carefully.
n499bcbdeb1.why: AM Best is a rating agency for insurers, and its views on loss exposures influence how insurers price and reserve for risk. Conflict-related losses can hit property, aviation and business interruption cover.

nfb326e0342.headline: SoftBank Group's PayPay Targets $13.4 Billion Valuation in U.S. IPO
nfb326e0342.summary: SoftBank Group's payments app operator PayPay is targeting a valuation of up to $13.4 billion in a US initial public offering. The move could bolster the Japanese technology sector.
nfb326e0342.why: SoftBank Group is a major Japanese technology investor and PayPay is one of its key fintech holdings. Large IPOs signal investor appetite for fintech and affect the value of the parent's stake.

impacts.name: SoftBank Group
impacts.why: As parent of PayPay, SoftBank's holding value could be affected by the IPO valuation.

ne5159f4ffe.headline: Carney in Australia to build on ‘important’ trade, defence relationship - National | Globalnews.ca
ne5159f4ffe.summary: Canada's prime minister arrived in Sydney to meet business leaders before heading to Canberra. He will address the Australian Parliament on Thursday.
ne5159f4ffe.why: Canada and Australia are both resource-exporting economies, and bilateral trade and defence agreements affect commodity flows and government procurement.

n8d8b921e08.headline: STAAR Surgical Q4 Loss Narrows
n8d8b921e08.summary: STAAR Surgical reported a fourth-quarter net loss of $18.3 million, or $0.37 per share, narrowing from a $34.2 million loss a year earlier.
n8d8b921e08.why: STAAR Surgical makes implantable lenses for eye surgery, and its quarterly results give investors a read on demand for its ophthalmic products.

n499ae597e2.headline: Seascape developer put into receivership
n499ae597e2.summary: Calibre Partners is now running Seascape's developer, the company building New Zealand's tallest tower. The company was placed into receivership.
n499ae597e2.why: Receivership means an appointed receiver takes control of a failing company's assets to repay creditors. Property developer failures can signal stress in New Zealand's construction and property sector.

neae1270687.headline: European Gas Prices Soar 30% as Qatar Halts LNG Output
neae1270687.summary: Qatar, the world's second-largest LNG exporter, has ceased production after military attacks on operating facilities. Europe's benchmark gas prices rose about 70 per cent since Friday's close, according to the report.
neae1270687.why: Qatar is a major LNG supplier, and Europe relies on LNG imports to replace pipeline gas. Supply disruptions there quickly lift European gas benchmarks and power costs.
neae1270687.why_moved: Qatar stopped LNG production after attacks on operating facilities, cutting a major supply source. European benchmark gas prices rose roughly 70 per cent since Friday's close.

nf178041bc5.headline: Stocks Sink as Crude Oil Surge Rattles Markets
nf178041bc5.summary: The S&P 500 fell 2.18%, the Dow dropped 2.27% and the Nasdaq 100 lost 2.37% as crude oil surged. March E-mini S&P futures were down 2.05%.
nf178041bc5.why: The S&P 500 and Dow track large US listed companies, so broad sell-offs signal shifts in investor risk appetite.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index fell 2.18% as crude oil surged and rattled markets.

nf178041bc5.why_moved: A surge in crude oil prices rattled investors, pushing major US equity indexes sharply lower.

nc0b8c27c1f.headline: 400,000 tons stuck in transit: Iran conflict disrupts India's basmati exports - BusinessToday
nc0b8c27c1f.summary: About 400,000 tons of basmati rice are stuck in transit as the Iran conflict disrupts India's exports. India is the world's largest exporter of premium basmati.
nc0b8c27c1f.why: India dominates global premium basmati rice exports, so shipping disruptions in the Gulf region affect both Indian exporters and importing countries.

n6c4d8f168e.headline: Sell-Off By Gold Stocks Leads To Nosedive On Bay Street
n6c4d8f168e.summary: Canadian stocks reversed from earlier gains to move substantially lower on Tuesday, with a sell-off in gold stocks leading the decline on Bay Street.
n6c4d8f168e.why: Toronto's Bay Street hosts the TSX, which has a large weighting in gold miners and resource companies.
n6c4d8f168e.why_moved: A sell-off in gold stocks drove the broader Canadian market lower after an early recovery.

ne741f80056.headline: Asian shares are mostly lower as investors focus on the Iran war
ne741f80056.summary: Asian shares were mostly lower as investors focused on the Iran war. South Korean shares sank 4.8% as markets reopened after a holiday on Monday.
ne741f80056.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock market index, and South Korea is a major exporter sensitive to global trade and energy costs.
ne741f80056.why_moved: Investors are reacting to the Iran war, and the sell-off came when South Korean markets reopened after a holiday.

nfdc3316052.headline: China poised to trim growth ambitions in five-year plan
nfdc3316052.summary: Analysts expect Premier Li Qiang to announce a growth target of between 4.5% and 5% in China's five-year plan. The target would be lower than previous ambitions.
nfdc3316052.why: China's growth targets guide government spending and policy, and they affect global demand for commodities and exports.

n176486b88d.headline: FBM KLCI rebounds amid ongoing concerns over Middle East conflict
n176486b88d.summary: The FBM KLCI outperformed most regional benchmarks, retracing the previous day's losses on optimism that a global equities rally will survive the Middle East fallout.
n176486b88d.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's main equity benchmark, tracking the largest companies listed in Kuala Lumpur.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The index itself rebounded after a prior-day decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n176486b88d.why_moved: Investors bet that the global equity rally can withstand the Middle East conflict, lifting the index after a previous-day loss.

nbe5e163366.headline: Iran strikes US embassy in Saudi Arabia as war expands yet again
nbe5e163366.summary: Iran struck the US embassy in Saudi Arabia as the war expands, and President Trump had projected the military operation could last four to five weeks.
nbe5e163366.why: Escalation between Iran and US allies in the Gulf raises risks to regional oil supply and shipping.
nbe5e163366.why_moved: The widening of the conflict to Gulf states raises fears of supply disruption and drives risk aversion.

n63453298b7.headline: Trump's 'whatever it takes' vow deepens stock selloff, lifts oil
n63453298b7.summary: Global markets were gripped by heightened uncertainty as U.S. President Donald Trump sought to defend his stance on the Iran conflict. The selloff deepened and oil prices rose.
n63453298b7.why: US equities such as the S&P 500 are the main global risk benchmark, and crude oil prices feed directly into inflation and corporate costs.
n63453298b7.why_moved: Escalating Iran war uncertainty and Trump's stated commitment to continue the conflict drove risk aversion across markets and lifted oil.

n1cb80df33d.headline: Oil markets' bet on a brief Iran shock is about to be tested - Academia
n1cb80df33d.summary: Oilfields in the region escaped damage, but the inability to ship fuel out of the Gulf is straining a tightly interconnected global energy system, according to the report.
n1cb80df33d.why: Oil market pricing depends on expectations of how long supply disruptions last, which directly shapes crude and fuel prices.

nae9282accb.headline: Petronet LNG, GAIL in focus as QatarEnergy production halt sends natural gas futures soaring 32% - BusinessToday
nae9282accb.summary: A QatarEnergy production halt sent natural gas futures soaring 32%. Indian LNG importers Petronet LNG and GAIL were in focus because they hold long-term supply contracts with Qatar Energy.
nae9282accb.why: QatarEnergy is one of the world's largest LNG suppliers, so production disruptions quickly move global gas prices and importers' costs.
nae9282accb.why_moved: A halt at QatarEnergy production cut LNG supply, sending natural gas futures sharply higher.

n402f533d43.headline: Cursor’s annualised revenue crosses $2 billion mark in February: Report
n402f533d43.summary: AI coding startup Cursor's annualised revenue crossed $2 billion in February, according to a report. Sales doubled in three months, with nearly 60% now from corporate customers.
n402f533d43.why: Cursor is an AI coding tool maker, and its fast revenue growth is a key test of commercial demand for generative AI software.

n6d8cd2c378.headline: Valeura Energy Responds To Thailand’s Request To Support Domestic Oil Aupply
n6d8cd2c378.summary: Valeura Energy is seeking clarification from Thailand's Ministry of Energy after a request for domestic producers to delay facility downtime and suspend crude exports amid Middle East supply disruptions.
n6d8cd2c378.why: Valeura Energy is a Canadian-listed oil and gas producer with operations in Thailand, so government export or maintenance requests directly affect its output.

n511d5193b3.headline: Iran-US Tensions Escalate: US Embassy in Riyadh Hit, Trump Warns of Strikes
n511d5193b3.summary: Iranian drones struck the US embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, while US and Israeli airstrikes against Iranian positions intensified.
n511d5193b3.why: Saudi Arabia is a leading oil producer, so attacks in the kingdom raise concerns over energy supply and regional stability.

n67e27ca724.headline: Saudi oil refinery shutdown: Brent crude prices could hit triple digit mark; here's how  - BusinessToday
n67e27ca724.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery came under drone attack from Iran and was temporarily shut on Monday.
n67e27ca724.why: Ras Tanura is one of the largest oil refineries in the world, and its outages directly tighten global refined fuel and crude markets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: A temporary refinery shutdown removes Saudi processing capacity and tightens global oil supply.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n67e27ca724.why_moved: A drone attack from Iran temporarily shut the Ras Tanura refinery, raising concerns over Saudi oil supply and pushing prices higher.

n8d65f5e740.headline: Oil prices jump 8% as US-Iran conflict widens
n8d65f5e740.summary: Oil prices jumped 8% as the US-Iran conflict widened. Saudi Aramco is seeking to reroute some crude exports to avoid the Strait of Hormuz.
n8d65f5e740.why: Brent is the main international crude benchmark, and Saudi Aramco is the world's largest state oil producer. Shipping disruption through Hormuz directly affects global crude supply.
n8d65f5e740.why_moved: The conflict widening threatens shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, prompting a sharp rise in crude prices.

nfc52664faf.headline: Average US Gas Price Jump Overnight: AAA
nfc52664faf.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline in the United States jumped overnight, according to AAA. The rise comes as oil prices have been volatile amid the Iran war.
nfc52664faf.why: Gasoline prices feed directly into consumer spending and headline inflation. Refiners and fuel retailers are sensitive to swings in crude costs.
